annotations.text:
Archival — chosen, and now built.

One ink, one paper. State is carried by weight, italics, opacity and a ruled underline, so nothing depends on seeing a hue: the page reads correctly in monochrome and under every colour-vision difference.

The earlier design needed a rule — never colour alone. This one cannot break it.

The qualifier logic survived the change of direction intact: state as a mark you recognise, only the consequence as words, each caveat scoped to the claim it weakens.

Only its expression moved — from tinted pills to ruled mono marks.
Unchanged throughout. The flows were never the problem.

Kept for the record.

Editorial — the gazette number as hero, one hot signal colour, dark by default. The most memorable of the three.

Civic — ochre and seal red on paper stock, drawn from Sri Lankan civic print. The most rooted, and the most at risk of costume.
